title: Curiosity rover views (Navcam)

source.locations: NASA MSL rover localisation (MMGIS MSL_waypoints.json), exact RMC

method: Left Navcam full frames taken at the stop, each reprojected into an equirectangular panorama (site frame: azimuth from north, elevation from horizontal) with the CAHVOR camera model and rover attitude NASA publishes with the image. Each panorama pixel comes from the frame that sees it nearest that frame's centre; per-frame brightness gains even out exposure. Black: not imaged at this stop.
limitations: Raw frames: seams, exposure steps and the rover's own hardware are visible as delivered.
Distant terrain only: nearby ground is not corrected for the small parallax between frames.
